text:
aj: quick idea 30 a lightweight launch post that funnels people into a short in-app guided tryout (3 tiny steps). Complete the guide and you unlock a starter credit + webinar seat. goal: move people from signup -> actual prompt usage.

elaine: love pushing for real engagement. two quick q's: how big is the starter credit, and do we promote the guide or the webinar as the primary CTA?

aj: starter credit = 500 tokens (enough for ~2 medium responses). CTA variants: A) "Try the guided demo" B) "Save my webinar seat" 3 we'll split at the post level.

samir: routing implications: we need tags for "guided-tryout" and "webinar-lp". credit issuance rules: unlock on guide completion OR on first meaningful generation, depending on arm. also add event hooks: email_verified, guide_completed, first_generation, credit_issued. i'll wire HubSpot + internal routing.

toni: fraud controls: one credit per verified email + domain throttle for public domains. add an email verification gate before credit is usable. also require a small phone-checkpoint for bulk org signups if domain > 5 signups/day.

maria: i'll draft the guided steps and 3 demo prompts. public landing should show 1-sentence bench claim we can defend. propose we use an internal pilot metric: "median minutes to first substantive result" with a clear definition (response length > 20 chars AND user didn't immediately delete).

maria: demo prompts (to be embedded in the tryout):

- Step 1 (starter): "Draft 3 short benefit bullets for this feature: <paste feature name>"
- Step 2 (role play): "You are a PM. List 3 integration considerations for adding LLM autocomplete vs full composer."
- Step 3 (playground): "Given user message: <paste>, ask one clarifying question and give a concise follow-up response."

elaine: copy tone: use "starter credit" not "free". landing blurb options: 1) "Try it now with a guided demo + starter credit" 2) "See how fast you can get a useful answer" 3 i'll draft both. also craft an email sequence: nudge -> reminder -> post-webinar follow-up with prompt pack.

aj: benchmark narrative suggestion (please vet): "Customers in our pilot reached a useful first result 20% faster with the guided demo vs baseline onboarding." metric = median time to first useful output; success target = 15% improvement and +12% 7-day active rate. we need to be able to cite sample size and method on request.

samir: implementation checklist (short):
1) post + CTA variants and UTM tracking
2) landing -> signup -> tag assignment
3) guided tryout flow in product (3 steps)
4) credit unlock logic (immediate vs deferred)
5) events & metrics (guide_started, guide_completed, first_use_quality_flag, credit_claimed)
6) routing rules to nurture vs sales based on tags
I'll take routing + instrumentation.

toni: add fraud checklist item: detect rapid multi-email patterns and block credit issuance pending manual review.

aj: owners confirmed: aj = owner/metrics, elaine = creative + emails, samir = routing/instrumentation, maria = guided content + prompt pack, toni = fraud & gating.

growth-bot: experiment board created -> https://rbw.in/exp/1777777777. arms: CTA_A (guide-first), CTA_B (webinar-first), CreditTiming_A (unlock-on-complete), CreditTiming_B (unlock-on-first-use). KPIs preloaded.

aj: timeline: draft copy + guided steps by Tue EOD, basic flow QA Wed, soft-launch with limited traffic Thu. if blockers surface, pause.

elaine: I'll post copy drafts in the doc and ping here. leaning to promote the guide as primary CTA to bias for action.

maria: will prepare a short prompt pack to include in the post and the post-webinar email. also preparing a short demo recording for the webinar.

aj: nice. small ask to growth-bot 3 add a column for "public bench copy" so legal/comms can sign off easily.

growth-bot: added column "public bench copy" and set reviewers to @elaine + @legal.

elaine: perfect. let's try to keep the public claim conservative and include the sample definition in the internal notes.

aj: thanks all 3 if no major issues, we run the split on Thu morning PST.

samir: will share a short spec for webhook behavior (email_verified -> allow credit redemption).

toni: will draft the fraud rules and share thresholds.

elainE: (typo) sending CTAs now...

aj: :rocket:
